title: New York City — Interview Day Guide

address.heading: Where to go
address.addressHtml:
386 Park Ave S
3rd Floor
New York, NY 10016

paragraphs.html: Taking the subway is the choice of many NY Boxers. Below are the nearest stops to the office:

items: 28th and Broadway (N, Q, W, R lines)

paragraphs.html: Enter the building and proceed to the 3rd floor. Check in with building or Box reception when you arrive.

cards.title: Photo ID
cards.body: Please bring a valid government ID (license, passport, or other government-issued ID) to verify your identity at check-in.

cards.title: NDA
cards.body: Before your scheduled interview, please ensure that you electronically sign our NDA using Box Sign through the link provided by your Recruiting Coordinator.

cards.title: Arrival & departure
cards.body: Your host will escort you to the interview area. Sign out at reception when you are finished.

contact.heading: Questions?
contact.body: Got a question we didn't cover? Reach out to your Recruiter and Recruiting Coordinator.
